title: Regression check: certifications in 'active' status show workflow action buttons
description: Sanity guard for a previously shipped defect where CERT_STATUS_ACTIONS had no 'active' key and WorkflowActionPanel rendered null for active certifications, permanently freezing them.
steps: Look at the workflow action control on the card/detail page
expectedResult: At least one action button is visible (e.g. 'Mark Expiring Soon' with a dropdown for Revoke/Archive/Request Revision) — the panel does not render blank.

title: Regression check: the Approve action still requires a 30-character justification note before it can be submitted
steps: Open a certification in 'under_review' status and click 'Approve'
Leave the justification note blank and observe the Approve button state
Type a 15-character note and observe the button state again
expectedResult: The Approve button is disabled both when the note is empty and when it is under 30 characters, with a live '{n}/30' counter — it never becomes clickable below the 30-character threshold.

title: Regression check: a transition note typed by the user actually reaches the backend and is retrievable afterward
steps: Submit a 'Request Revision' with a distinctive note text (e.g. include today's date and a random word)
Immediately re-open the certification's workflow/audit history
expectedResult: The distinctive note text appears verbatim in the workflow history entry — it is not blank, generic, or silently dropped.

title: Regression check: the incident date field still rejects a future date
steps: Attempt to pick tomorrow's date in the Incident Date field
expectedResult: The date picker's max attribute prevents selecting a future date, and if bypassed (e.g. via direct input manipulation) the form shows 'Incident date cannot be in the future' and blocks submission.

title: Regression check: 'Generate Link' stays disabled for a password-protected share link until the password contains at least one digit
steps: Open Share Link modal, enable Password Protection
expectedResult: The button remains disabled with the tooltip 'Password does not meet complexity requirements' until a digit is added — this client-side gate has not regressed.
